title: Improper Content Security Policy (CSP) nonce implementation in HCL BigFix MCM allows a remote attacker to reduce the…
description: HCL BigFix MCM has an improper implementation of the Content Security Policy (CSP) nonce mechanism. This flaw allows a remote attacker to weaken the CSP protection by exploiting an orphaned nonce value in the style-src directive of the CSP header, which is not matched by any nonce attribute on <style> or <script> elements. The vulnerability has a low severity score and does not impact confidentiality, integrity, or availability significantly.
